rows.text: En el embrague seco las superficies de fricción trabajan sin baño de aceite; en el de baño de aceite, los discos están sumergidos en lubricante, que ayuda a enfriarlos.
evidence: US Navy technical manual https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655906/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6550.pdf chapter 10: wet clutch lubrication and dry friction clutch.

Stüwe, multiple disc clutches, https://stuewe-ag.ch/en/multiple-disc-clutches/ — depending on design multi-plate clutches can operate dry or in an oil bath; industrial engineering example, not a road-vehicle equipment mandate.

rows.text: El mando puede transmitir la acción del pedal mediante un circuito hidráulico; en vehículos pesados también puede tener asistencia neumática.
evidence: https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — ZF describes clutch hydraulic master/slave actuation and torque converters for automatic transmissions.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html — ZF describes hydraulic clutch control and clutch servo for commercial vehicles.
https://truck.knorr-bremse.com/en/us/products/drivetrain/clutch-actuation/ — Clutch Servo Longlife uses hydraulic pedal pressure and compressed-air assistance.

rows.text: Una transmisión automática no requiere necesariamente un embrague monodisco: también existen transmisiones con convertidor de par o embrague multidisco.
evidence: https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — ZF describes clutch hydraulic master/slave actuation and torque converters for automatic transmissions.

https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64422.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792 — ZF describes a wet multidisc starting clutch for automated transmissions of construction vehicles and mobile cranes.

rows.text: El embrague forma parte de la transmisión: conecta y desconecta el motor de la caja de cambios, y no es parte de la suspensión.
evidence: https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — ZF describes clutch hydraulic master/slave actuation and torque converters for automatic transmissions.

https://www.mysubaru360.com/manuals_and_documents/Subaru_360_Autoclutch_manual.pdf — Subaru 360 Auto-Clutch manual p. 5 describes electromagnetic powder connecting engine and transmission when current flows.

rows.text: Sí existen embragues de accionamiento automático: por ejemplo, una unidad electrónica puede regular su funcionamiento sin pedal.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/es/cv/products_64155.html — ZF describes electronically controlled automatic clutch actuation for heavy and medium commercial vehicles.

rows.text: Los vehículos pesados también pueden usar embragues multidisco: existen para vehículos de construcción y grúas móviles.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64422.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792 — ZF describes a wet multidisc starting clutch for automated transmissions of construction vehicles and mobile cranes.

rows.text: Al desembragar se interrumpe la conexión entre motor y transmisión; al embragar se restablece.
evidence: https://www.mysubaru360.com/manuals_and_documents/Subaru_360_Autoclutch_manual.pdf — Subaru 360 Auto-Clutch manual p. 5 describes electromagnetic powder connecting engine and transmission when current flows.

rows.text: Al arrancar, embragar gradualmente transmite el par del motor de forma progresiva a las ruedas motrices mediante la transmisión y evita un tirón.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/guidance-for-driving-examiners-carrying-out-driving-tests-dt1/11-guide-to-assessment-and-marking — Control: smooth starts use accelerator and clutch, and clutch is depressed before stopping.

https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64422.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792 — ZF describes a wet multidisc starting clutch for automated transmissions of construction vehicles and mobile cranes.

rows.text: Con una marcha engranada y el embrague desembragado, el motor queda separado de la transmisión y puede seguir funcionando con el vehículo detenido.
evidence: https://www.mysubaru360.com/manuals_and_documents/Subaru_360_Autoclutch_manual.pdf — Subaru 360 Auto-Clutch manual p. 5 describes electromagnetic powder connecting engine and transmission when current flows.

https://www.gov.uk/guidance/guidance-for-driving-examiners-carrying-out-driving-tests-dt1/11-guide-to-assessment-and-marking — Control: smooth starts use accelerator and clutch, and clutch is depressed before stopping.

rows.text: Al disminuir la velocidad, baja la fuerza centrífuga y los resortes llevan las masas hacia adentro: el embrague se desacopla por debajo de su umbral de desacoplamiento, que puede diferir del de acoplamiento.
evidence: https://sucoesi.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/SUCO-Catalog-Clutches-and-Brakes-1.pdf — SUCO Transmission Technology, p. 10: springs retain flyweights; centrifugal force overcomes them and friction pads contact the outer drum at engagement speed.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US4294342 — centrifugal clutch operation: decreasing shaft speed lets spring force overcome centrifugal force, retracting shoes and disengaging.
Disengagement and engagement thresholds need not coincide; lowering-speed release is distinct from engagement speed.

Honda US patent 4,687,085, abstract, https://patents.justia.com/patent/4687085 — a centrifugal clutch design has hysteresis and different engaging and disengaging rotational speeds; example establishes possibility rather than a universal difference.

rows.text: En el mando hidráulico, el pedal genera presión en el líquido, que actúa sobre el cilindro de desembrague; el sistema puede facilitar el accionamiento.
evidence: https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — ZF describes clutch hydraulic master/slave actuation and torque converters for automatic transmissions.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html — ZF describes hydraulic clutch control and clutch servo for commercial vehicles.

rows.text: Al desembragar se interrumpe la transmisión del par del motor, lo que facilita cambiar de marcha; después se vuelve a embragar.
evidence: https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/ — ZF describes clutch hydraulic master/slave actuation and torque converters for automatic transmissions.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html — ZF describes hydraulic clutch control and clutch servo for commercial vehicles.

rows.text: El embrague progresivo permite que la transmisión reciba gradualmente el movimiento del motor y hace más suave el arranque.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/guidance-for-driving-examiners-carrying-out-driving-tests-dt1/11-guide-to-assessment-and-marking — Control: smooth starts use accelerator and clutch, and clutch is depressed before stopping.

https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64422.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792 — ZF describes a wet multidisc starting clutch for automated transmissions of construction vehicles and mobile cranes.

rows.text: En un embrague centrífugo, al aumentar las revoluciones las masas se desplazan hacia afuera y su contacto embraga automáticamente.
evidence: https://sucoesi.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/SUCO-Catalog-Clutches-and-Brakes-1.pdf — SUCO Transmission Technology, p. 10: springs retain flyweights; centrifugal force overcomes them and friction pads contact the outer drum at engagement speed.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US4294342 — centrifugal clutch operation: decreasing shaft speed lets spring force overcome centrifugal force, retracting shoes and disengaging.

rows.text: Cuando no se necesita accionar el pedal, hay que retirar el pie: apoyarlo puede causar desgaste prematuro o un desembrague involuntario.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/615524/2017-04336.pdf — Land Rover 110 operating manual chapter 3-1 section 28.7: do not rest foot on clutch pedal; premature wear and unintended disengagement can result.

rows.text: Una unidad electrónica puede controlar automáticamente el actuador del embrague según las condiciones de marcha y las acciones del conductor.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/es/cv/products_64155.html — ZF describes electronically controlled automatic clutch actuation for heavy and medium commercial vehicles.

rows.text: Existen embragues automáticos electromagnéticos: la corriente crea un campo magnético que permite la conexión y la transmisión del par.
evidence: https://www.mysubaru360.com/manuals_and_documents/Subaru_360_Autoclutch_manual.pdf — Subaru 360 Auto-Clutch manual p. 5 describes electromagnetic powder connecting engine and transmission when current flows.

rows.text: En el embrague centrífugo las masas se desplazan hacia afuera al aumentar las revoluciones y regresan hacia adentro al bajar, permitiendo embragar y desembragar.
evidence: https://sucoesi.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/SUCO-Catalog-Clutches-and-Brakes-1.pdf — SUCO Transmission Technology, p. 10: springs retain flyweights; centrifugal force overcomes them and friction pads contact the outer drum at engagement speed.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US4294342 — centrifugal clutch operation: decreasing shaft speed lets spring force overcome centrifugal force, retracting shoes and disengaging.

rows.text: Al aumentar las revoluciones crece la fuerza centrífuga: las masas se desplazan hacia afuera y pueden embragar.
evidence: https://sucoesi.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/SUCO-Catalog-Clutches-and-Brakes-1.pdf — SUCO Transmission Technology, p. 10: springs retain flyweights; centrifugal force overcomes them and friction pads contact the outer drum at engagement speed.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US4294342 — centrifugal clutch operation: decreasing shaft speed lets spring force overcome centrifugal force, retracting shoes and disengaging.

rows.text: Incluso con el vehículo cargado, el embrague permite transmitir el par gradualmente al arrancar, haciendo más suave la salida.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64422.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792 — ZF describes a wet multidisc starting clutch for automated transmissions of construction vehicles and mobile cranes.

https://www.gov.uk/guidance/guidance-for-driving-examiners-carrying-out-driving-tests-dt1/11-guide-to-assessment-and-marking — Control: smooth starts use accelerator and clutch, and clutch is depressed before stopping.

rows.text: Durante la marcha no se debe apoyar el pie en el pedal: una presión involuntaria puede causar desgaste prematuro o desembragar.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/615524/2017-04336.pdf — Land Rover 110 operating manual chapter 3-1 section 28.7: do not rest foot on clutch pedal; premature wear and unintended disengagement can result.

rows.text: Al aumentar las revoluciones, la fuerza centrífuga desplaza las masas hacia afuera, no hacia adentro.
evidence: https://sucoesi.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/SUCO-Catalog-Clutches-and-Brakes-1.pdf — SUCO Transmission Technology, p. 10: springs retain flyweights; centrifugal force overcomes them and friction pads contact the outer drum at engagement speed.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US4294342 — centrifugal clutch operation: decreasing shaft speed lets spring force overcome centrifugal force, retracting shoes and disengaging.

rows.text: Cuando bajan las revoluciones disminuye la fuerza centrífuga y los resortes devuelven las masas hacia adentro, no hacia afuera.
evidence: https://sucoesi.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/SUCO-Catalog-Clutches-and-Brakes-1.pdf — SUCO Transmission Technology, p. 10: springs retain flyweights; centrifugal force overcomes them and friction pads contact the outer drum at engagement speed.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US4294342 — centrifugal clutch operation: decreasing shaft speed lets spring force overcome centrifugal force, retracting shoes and disengaging.

rows.text: Cuando bajan las revoluciones, los resortes pueden devolver las masas hacia adentro: no necesariamente permanecen inmóviles.
evidence: https://sucoesi.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/SUCO-Catalog-Clutches-and-Brakes-1.pdf — SUCO Transmission Technology, p. 10: springs retain flyweights; centrifugal force overcomes them and friction pads contact the outer drum at engagement speed.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US4294342 — centrifugal clutch operation: decreasing shaft speed lets spring force overcome centrifugal force, retracting shoes and disengaging.

rows.text: El embrague conecta y desconecta el motor y la transmisión; la dirección controla el rumbo del vehículo.
evidence: https://www.mysubaru360.com/manuals_and_documents/Subaru_360_Autoclutch_manual.pdf — Subaru 360 Auto-Clutch manual p. 5 describes electromagnetic powder connecting engine and transmission when current flows.
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/guidance-for-driving-examiners-carrying-out-driving-tests-dt1/11-guide-to-assessment-and-marking — Control distinguishes clutch and steering controls.
